candidate_windows.window_text: All models mentioned in Table 4 have released their source codes, and we have used the same settings as the original papers. The Roberta-based method (Baseline) described in this paper is based on EmoBERTa (Kim and Vossen, 2021), with the difference being that we do not consider the impact of future utterances on the model. Furthermore, we have utilized a grid search technique to determine the optimal values for the parameters $\lambda$ , $\beta$ , and $\gamma$ on the validation set. The grid search is performed with a step size of 0.1 and a range spanning from -2 to 2. The results reported in the tables are the average scores from 5 random runs on the test set.
